label: TSP sodium-salt + 6 D2O candidate raw 1H/13C model
raw_calculation_reference: Raw sigma(1H/13C) for the trimethylsilyl resonance of a declared TSP-/Na+/6D2O cluster
experimental_processing_convention: Use only if the actual acquisition used the matching TSP/TSP-d4 convention; indirect referencing remains a separate non-molecular processing route
model_limitation: Exact isotopologue, pD, sodium ion pairing and hydration must be confirmed; non-deuterated and TSP-d4 models are not silently interchangeable
raw_shielding_aggregation_policy: PRESERVE_EACH_REQUESTED_ATOM_VALUE; within each nucleus and this single approved reference model, report n, arithmetic mean, population standard deviation, minimum and maximum over the declared chemically equivalent reference-site atoms; never average across different models, isotopologues, solvent domains, conformers or experimental processing conventions
initial_cluster_geometry_role: DRAFT_COLLISION_SCREENED_START_ONLY; requires reviewed optimization/frequency minimum before shielding and is not a converged solvation ensemble
